notes: I changed the shoulder rule: E16 confirms the positive shoulder is a *separate additive* linear ramp only in the interval [-6, -3] (0 at -6, rising ~0.0013/step to 0.008 at -3), not a ramp extending below -6 as v7 had it. This removes the spurious positive contribution at x<-6 that made v7 predict too-high values there (e.g. -0.0007 vs observed -0.0012 at x=-20).
